{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- resolve current inventory for a given set/fig
cur_inv AS (
  SELECT set_num, id AS inventory_id FROM (
    SELECT set_num, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn FROM inventories
  ) WHERE rn=1
),
-- start: version 1 of 7970-1
start AS (SELECT id AS inventory_id FROM inventories WHERE set_num='7970-1' AND version=1),
-- recursive explosion: (inventory_id, multiplier)
explode AS (
  SELECT inventory_id, 1 AS mult FROM start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ci.inventory_id, e.mult * x.qty
  FROM explode e
  JOIN (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS child, quantity AS qty FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS child, quantity AS qty FROM inventory_minifigs
  ) x ON x.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  JOIN cur_inv ci ON ci.set_num = x.child
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.part_num) AS n
FROM explode e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE NOT ip.is_spare"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory for set 9472-1
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, 1 AS quantity
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '9472-1'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '9472-1')
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the set's inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- Each row represents: inventory_id to expand, the multiplier for that inventory
expanded AS (
    -- Base: the set's own inventory
    SELECT si.inventory_id, si.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: each nested set contributes its current inventory * quantity
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i2.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: each minifig contributes its current inventory * quantity
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i2.set_num)
)
-- Sum up all part 10048 across all expanded inventories, excluding spare parts
SELECT SUM(ip.quantity * e.multiplier) AS total_units
FROM expanded e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '10048'
AND ip.is_spare = false
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- recursive expansion: each row is (inventory_id, part_num, qty) for parts reachable from that inventory
rec(inventory_id, part_num, qty) AS (
  -- base: direct parts of any inventory
  SELECT inventory_id, part_num, quantity FROM inventory_parts WHERE NOT is_spare
  UNION ALL
  -- nested sets: expand child set's current inventory
  SELECT ci.id, r.part_num, r.qty * iset.quantity
  FROM rec r
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN inventories ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
    AND ci.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = iset.set_num)
  UNION ALL
  -- minifigs: expand minifig's current inventory
  SELECT ci.id, r.part_num, r.qty * im.quantity
  FROM rec r
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN inventories ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    AND ci.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = im.fig_num)
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_parts
FROM rec
WHERE inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num='41663-1' AND version=2)"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get the current inventory (highest version) for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
set_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts in the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '5004718-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (recursively)
    SELECT 
        sc.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        sc.qty * ip.quantity as qty,
        sc.level + 1
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = sc.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND sc.level < 10  -- safety limit
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (recursively)
    SELECT 
        sc.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        sc.qty * ip.quantity as qty,
        sc.level + 1
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = sc.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND sc.level < 10  -- safety limit
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) as total_units
FROM set_contents
WHERE part_num = '32034'
"}

set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '41067-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion: track (inventory_id, multiplier) pairs
-- Start with the set's inventory with multiplier 1
to_expand AS (
    SELECT si.inventory_id, 1 AS multiplier
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: their current inventory with multiplied quantity
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        (te.multiplier * isets.quantity) AS multiplier
    FROM to_expand te
    JOIN inventory_sets isets ON isets.inventory_id = te.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = isets.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON i.set_num = latest.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: their current inventory with multiplied quantity
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        (te.multiplier * im.quantity) AS multiplier
    FROM to_expand te
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = te.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON i.set_num = latest.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
),
-- Get all unique (inventory_id, multiplier) pairs (deduplicate since same inventory can be reached via different paths)
all_expansions AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, multiplier
    FROM to_expand
),
-- Sum up all parts 15573 across all expanded inventories with their multipliers
total_parts AS (

    FROM all_expansions ae
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ae.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '15573'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT total_quantity FROM total_parts

-- Get current inventory id for any set_num or fig_num
latest_inventory(item_num, inv_id) AS (
    SELECT set_num, id
    FROM (
        SELECT set_num, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
        FROM inventories
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Recursive expansion starting from set 70627-1
-- Each row: (inv_id of container, part_num, color_id, quantity, path)
expanded AS (
    -- Base: set 70627-1's inventory parts
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        ARRAY['70627-1']::VARCHAR[] AS path
    FROM latest_inventory li
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = li.inv_id
    WHERE li.item_num = '70627-1'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: find sets inside current inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * iset.quantity AS qty,
        array_append(e.path, iset.set_num)
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN latest_inventory li ON li.item_num = e.path[array_length(e.path, 1)]
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = li.inv_id
    JOIN latest_inventory li2 ON li2.item_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = li2.inv_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND NOT (iset.set_num = ANY(e.path))  -- avoid cycles
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: find minifigs inside current inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * im.quantity AS qty,
        array_append(e.path, im.fig_num)
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN latest_inventory li ON li.item_num = e.path[array_length(e.path, 1)]
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = li.inv_id
    JOIN latest_inventory li2 ON li2.item_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = li2.inv_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND NOT (im.fig_num = ANY(e.path))  -- avoid cycles
)
SELECT part_num, color_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM expanded
WHERE part_num = '98132'
GROUP BY part_num, color_id
ORDER BY total_qty DESC"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
  -- Get the current inventory (highest version) for set 76428-1
  SELECT id, set_num
  FROM inventories
  WHERE set_num = '76428-1'
    AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '76428-1')
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
  -- Base: start with the set's own inventory parts (non-spare)
  SELECT 
    ci.id as root_inventory_id,
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    CAST(ip.quantity AS BIGINT) as quantity,
    1 as level
  FROM current_inventory ci
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Nested sets: multiply quantity and recurse into their current inventory parts
  SELECT 
    e.root_inventory_id,
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    CAST(e.quantity * iset.quantity * ip.quantity AS BIGINT) as quantity,
    e.level + 1
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.root_inventory_id
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = iset.set_num
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num)
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  AND e.level = 1  -- Only process direct nested sets from root to avoid double counting
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Minifigs: multiply quantity and recurse into their inventory parts
  SELECT 
    e.root_inventory_id,
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    CAST(e.quantity * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS BIGINT) as quantity,
    e.level + 1
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.root_inventory_id
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = im.fig_num
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  AND e.level = 1  -- Only process direct minifigs from root to avoid double counting
)

SELECT SUM(quantity) as total_parts FROM exploded
"}

    )

)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the current inventory for set 75550-1
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '75550-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the set's inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the multiplier from parent quantities
expanded AS (
    -- Base: the set's own inventory
    SELECT 
        si.inventory_id,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        si.set_num AS item_id
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: find sets inside current inventories
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * isets.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        isets.set_num AS item_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets isets ON isets.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = isets.set_num
    -- Get current inventory version for the nested set
    WHERE child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = isets.set_num
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: find minifigs inside current inventories
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = im.fig_num
    -- Get current inventory version for the minifig
    WHERE child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num
    )
),
-- Get all inventory IDs from the expanded tree (including the root)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, qty_multiplier FROM expanded
),
-- Sum parts from all inventories, multiplying by the path quantity
parts_sum AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ip.quantity * ai.qty_multiplier), 0) AS total_parts
    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ai.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT total_parts FROM parts_sum
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the current inventory version for each set/fig
latest_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
-- Start with set 853556-1's current inventory
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT li.id AS inventory_id
    FROM latest_inventories li
    WHERE li.set_num = '853556-1' AND li.rn = 1
),
-- Recursive: at each level, we track (inventory_id, multiplier)
-- We need to find all parts reachable from the starting set
recurse AS (
    -- Base: the starting set's inventory
    SELECT si.inventory_id, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS mult
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- From any inventory, find nested sets and their current inventories
    SELECT li.id AS inventory_id, r.mult * CAST(iset.quantity AS BIGINT) AS mult
    FROM recurse r
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN latest_inventories li ON li.set_num = iset.set_num AND li.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- From any inventory, find minifigs and their current inventories
    SELECT li.id AS inventory_id, r.mult * CAST(im.quantity AS BIGINT) AS mult
    FROM recurse r
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN latest_inventories li ON li.set_num = im.fig_num AND li.rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.part_num)
FROM recurse r
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
WHERE ip.is_spare = false"}

    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '70909-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the target inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the inventory_id we're currently expanding
expanded(inventory_id, item_type, item_num, quantity, depth) AS (
    -- Base: the target set's own inventory
    SELECT ti.inventory_id, 'set', '70909-1', 1, 0
    FROM target_inventory ti
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: a set in inventory_sets points to another set, which has its own current inventory
    SELECT 
        (SELECT i2.id FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = iset.set_num ORDER BY i2.version DESC LIMIT 1),
        'set',
        iset.set_num,
        e.quantity * iset.quantity,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: a minifig has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        (SELECT i2.id FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = im.fig_num ORDER BY i2.version DESC LIMIT 1),
        'minifig',
        im.fig_num,
        e.quantity * im.quantity,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),
-- Get all inventory IDs at any level (deduplicate since same inventory might be reached multiple ways)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT inventory_id FROM expanded WHERE inventory_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Collect all parts from all these inventories (excluding spares)
all_parts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ip.part_num
    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ai.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_part_numbers FROM all_parts

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory (max version) for each set_num/fig_num
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
set_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with set 75291-1's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        1 as quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '75291-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        sc.quantity * isets.quantity as quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_sets isets ON isets.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = isets.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into minifigs (minifigs have their own inventories)
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        sc.quantity * im.quantity as quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.part_num) as distinct_part_numbers
FROM set_contents sc
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
"}

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the current inventory for the target set
target_inventory AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '9788325344535-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the target inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the inventory_id we're currently exploring
expanded(inventory_id, depth) AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, 0 FROM target_inventory
    UNION ALL
    -- Nested sets: each nested set has its own current inventory
    SELECT i.id, e.depth + 1
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
    UNION ALL
    -- Minifigs: each minifig has its own inventory
    SELECT i.id, e.depth + 1
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
)
-- Get all distinct part numbers from all expanded inventories (excluding spare parts)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.part_num) AS distinct_part_numbers
FROM expanded e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
"}

    FROM inventories

    FROM expanded_sets e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
),
expanded_minifigs AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, depth FROM expanded_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.id, e.depth + 1
    FROM expanded_minifigs e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
),

    SELECT inventory_id FROM expanded_sets
    UNION
    SELECT inventory_id FROM expanded_minifigs
)

FROM all_inventories ai
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ai.inventory_id

),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the set's inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs

    -- Base: the set's own inventory

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find current inventory for set 45802-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '45802-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion of all items in the inventory
-- We track: inventory_id at each level, and what type of item it is
expanded AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity,
        0 AS level
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: inventory_sets points to a set, which has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.quantity * is2.quantity AS quantity,
        e.level + 1 AS level
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = is2.set_num
    -- Only current inventory for nested sets (highest version)
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i2.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: inventory_minifigs points to a minifig, which has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.quantity * im.quantity AS quantity,
        e.level + 1 AS level
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    -- Only current inventory for minifigs (highest version)
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i2.set_num)
)
-- Get all distinct part numbers from all expanded inventories
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.part_num) AS distinct_part_numbers
FROM expanded e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
"}

WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
  -- Find current inventory version for each set/fig
  SELECT id, set_num, version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
  FROM inventories
),
current_inv AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM current_inventory WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Recursive expansion starting from set 71497-1
recursive_contents AS (
  -- Base: start with the inventory of set 71497-1
  SELECT 
    ci.id as inventory_id,
    1 as quantity_multiplier,
    'set' as item_type,
    ci.set_num as item_id
  FROM current_inv ci
  WHERE ci.set_num = '71497-1'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Expand nested sets: a nested set points to another inventory
  SELECT 
    ci2.id as inventory_id,
    rc.quantity_multiplier * inv_s.quantity as quantity_multiplier,
    'set' as item_type,
    ci2.set_num as item_id
  FROM recursive_contents rc
  JOIN inventory_sets inv_s ON inv_s.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
  JOIN current_inv ci2 ON ci2.set_num = inv_s.set_num
  WHERE rc.item_type = 'set'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Expand minifigs: a minifig points to its own inventory
  SELECT 
    ci2.id as inventory_id,
    rc.quantity_multiplier * inv_m.quantity as quantity_multiplier,
    'minifig' as item_type,
    ci2.set_num as item_id
  FROM recursive_contents rc
  JOIN inventory_minifigs inv_m ON inv_m.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
  JOIN current_inv ci2 ON ci2.set_num = inv_m.fig_num
  WHERE rc.item_type = 'set'
),
-- Get all part/color combinations from all reached inventories
all_parts AS (
  SELECT 
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    rc.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity as total_quantity
  FROM recursive_contents rc
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (part_num, color_id)) as distinct_part_color_combinations
FROM all_parts
"}

current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id

    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1

-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at any level
-- Each row represents: (part_num, color_id, quantity, depth)
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory (excluding spares)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity,
        1 AS depth
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 1: nested sets
    -- For each nested set, get its current inventory's parts
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * iset.quantity AS quantity,
        e.depth + 1 AS depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON latest.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.depth = 1  -- Only recurse from the top level to avoid double counting
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 2: minifigs
    -- For each minifig, get its current inventory's parts
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * im.quantity AS quantity,
        e.depth + 1 AS depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON latest.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.depth = 1  -- Only recurse from the top level
)
-- Count distinct part/color combinations
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (part_num, color_id)) AS distinct_part_color_combinations

    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory (excluding spares)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity,
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS depth
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: items from nested sets and minifigs
    -- Need to find all nested sets/minifigs in the current inventory being processed
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * child_items.qty AS quantity,
        child_items.child_inv_id,
        e.depth + 1 AS depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN (
        -- Get nested sets with their current inventory and quantity
        SELECT 
            iset.inventory_id AS parent_inv_id,
            iset.quantity AS qty,
            i.id AS child_inv_id
        FROM inventory_sets iset
        JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
        JOIN (
            SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
            FROM inventories
            GROUP BY set_num
        ) latest ON latest.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Get minifigs with their current inventory and quantity
        SELECT 
            im.inventory_id AS parent_inv_id,
            im.quantity AS qty,
            i.id AS child_inv_id
        FROM inventory_minifigs im
        JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
        JOIN (
            SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
            FROM inventories
            GROUP BY set_num
        ) latest ON latest.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = latest.max_version
    ) child_items ON child_items.parent_inv_id = e.current_inv_id
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = child_items.child_inv_id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
-- Count distinct part/color combinations
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (part_num, color_id)) AS distinct_part_color_combinations

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find the current inventory for set 66495-1
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '66495-1'

    -- Base: the top-level set itself
    SELECT si.set_num, 1 AS quantity, 0 AS level
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find sets nested within current level's inventories
    SELECT iset.set_num, ns.quantity * iset.quantity AS quantity, ns.level + 1
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ns.set_num
    -- Get the current inventory version for this nested set
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) iv ON i.set_num = iv.set_num AND i.version = iv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = i.id
),
-- Get all inventories for all sets found (current version only)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, ns.set_num, ns.quantity AS set_quantity
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ns.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) iv ON i.set_num = iv.set_num AND i.version = iv.max_version
)
-- Sum minifig quantities across all inventories, multiplying by set quantities
SELECT SUM(im.quantity * ai.set_quantity) AS total_minifigs
FROM all_inventories ai
JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ai.inventory_id
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get the current inventory (highest version) for each set
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM current_inventory WHERE rn = 1
),
set_contents AS (
    -- Base case: start with set 66453-1's inventory
    SELECT 
        ims.set_num as parent_set,
        ims.set_num as child_set,
        ims.quantity as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM inventory_sets ims
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ims.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '66453-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find nested sets
    SELECT 
        sc.child_set as parent_set,
        ims.set_num as child_set,
        sc.qty * ims.quantity as qty,
        sc.level + 1
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = sc.child_set
    JOIN inventory_sets ims ON ims.inventory_id = ci.id
),
all_sets AS (
    -- Include the top-level set itself with quantity 1
    SELECT '66453-1' as set_num, 1 as qty
    UNION ALL
    -- Include all nested sets with their quantities
    SELECT child_set, qty FROM set_contents
),
minifig_counts AS (
    -- Get minifigs from each set's current inventory, multiplied by set quantity
    SELECT 
        a.set_num,
        im.fig_num,
        a.qty * im.quantity as total_qty
    FROM all_sets a
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = a.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) as total_minifigs
FROM minifig_counts
"}

),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's inventory

           'set' as item_type, ci.set_num as item_num, ci.quantity as quantity_at_level
    FROM current_inventory ci

    -- Recursively expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT ec.root_inventory_id, ec.root_set_num,
           CASE WHEN ims.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END as item_type,
           COALESCE(ims.set_num, imf.fig_num) as item_num,
           ec.quantity_at_level * COALESCE(ims.quantity, imf.quantity) as quantity_at_level
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ec.item_num
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets ims ON ims.inventory_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ec.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ec.item_num)
)

FROM exploded_contents
WHERE item_type = 'minifig'

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get the current inventory for set 7287-1
set_inventory AS (
  SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num, i.version
  FROM inventories i
  WHERE i.set_num = '7287-1'
  ORDER BY i.version DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents at any level
exploded AS (
  -- Base: start with the set's inventory
  SELECT 
    si.inventory_id,
    si.set_num AS root_set,
    1 AS quantity_multiplier,
    'set' AS item_type,
    si.set_num AS item_id
  FROM set_inventory si
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Parts directly in this inventory
  SELECT 
    ip.inventory_id,
    e.root_set,
    e.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
    'part' AS item_type,
    ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id AS item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Nested sets
  SELECT 
    child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
    e.root_set,
    e.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
    'set' AS item_type,
    iset.set_num AS item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = iset.set_num
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    -- Get current inventory of nested set
    AND child_inv.version = (
      SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num
    )
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Minifigs
  SELECT 
    child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
    e.root_set,
    e.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
    'set' AS item_type,
    im.fig_num AS item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = im.fig_num
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    -- Get current inventory of minifig
    AND child_inv.version = (
      SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num
    )
)
-- Count distinct part/colour combinations
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS distinct_part_color_combinations
FROM exploded
WHERE item_type = 'part'
"}

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get current inventory id for a given set_num or fig_num
current_inv(item_num, inv_id) AS (
    SELECT set_num, id
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive explosion: start with set 42677-1, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- We'll track: the inventory we're expanding, the multiplier from parent quantities
explosion(inv_id, multiplier) AS (
    -- Start with the set itself
    SELECT inv_id, 1
    FROM current_inv
    WHERE item_num = '42677-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: their inventory * quantity
    SELECT ci.inv_id, e.multiplier * iset.quantity
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.item_num = iset.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: their inventory * quantity
    SELECT ci.inv_id, e.multiplier * im.quantity
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.item_num = im.fig_num
),
-- Get all parts from all exploded inventories, with proper multiplication
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * e.multiplier as total_qty,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inv_id
)

FROM all_parts
WHERE is_spare = true OR is_spare = false
"}

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find current inventory for set 71032-8
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '71032-8'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion of all items in an inventory
-- We track: inventory_id, item_type (part/set/minifig), item_id, quantity, path multiplier
expanded AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the set's inventory (including spare parts)
    SELECT 
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num as item_id,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as qty,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: nested sets from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        'set' as item_type,
        iset.set_num as item_id,
        NULL as color_id,
        iset.quantity as qty,
        NULL as is_spare
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: minifigs from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        'minifig' as item_type,
        im.fig_num as item_id,
        NULL as color_id,
        im.quantity as qty,
        NULL as is_spare
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets
    -- For each set in expanded, find its current inventory and add its contents
    SELECT 
        e2.item_type,
        e2.item_id,
        e2.color_id,
        e.qty * e2.qty as qty,
        e2.is_spare
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN (
        -- Get current inventory for any set in expanded
        SELECT i.id, i.set_num
        FROM inventories i
        WHERE i.version = (
            SELECT MAX(version) 
            FROM inventories i2 
            WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
        )
    ) ci ON ci.set_num = e.item_id AND e.item_type = 'set'
    JOIN (
        -- Parts in that inventory
        SELECT 'part' as item_type, part_num as item_id, color_id, quantity as qty, is_spare, inventory_id
        FROM inventory_parts
        UNION ALL
        -- Nested sets in that inventory
        SELECT 'set' as item_type, set_num as item_id, NULL as color_id, quantity as qty, NULL as is_spare, inventory_id
        FROM inventory_sets
        UNION ALL
        -- Minifigs in that inventory
        SELECT 'minifig' as item_type, fig_num as item_id, NULL as color_id, quantity as qty, NULL as is_spare, inventory_id
        FROM inventory_minifigs
    ) e2 ON e2.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand minifigs
    -- For each minifig in expanded, find its current inventory and add its parts
    SELECT 
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num as item_id,
        ip.color_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity as qty,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN (
        -- Get current inventory for any minifig in expanded
        SELECT i.id, i.set_num
        FROM inventories i
        WHERE i.version = (
            SELECT MAX(version) 
            FROM inventories i2 
            WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
        )
    ) ci ON ci.set_num = e.item_id AND e.item_type = 'minifig'
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
)
SELECT SUM(qty) as total_parts_including_spares
FROM expanded
WHERE item_type = 'part' AND (is_spare = true OR is_spare = false OR is_spare IS NULL)

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the current inventory for a given set_num or fig_num
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of a set
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with set 21360-1's inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        1 as quantity,  -- the set itself is 1 unit
        'set' as item_type,
        '21360-1' as item_id,
        0 as depth
    FROM current_inventory ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '21360-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in the inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ip.quantity,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num as item_id,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        e.quantity * iset.quantity as quantity,
        'set' as item_type,
        iset.set_num as item_id,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        e.quantity * im.quantity as quantity,
        'minifig' as item_type,
        im.fig_num as item_id,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
)

FROM exploded e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = ip.part_num

-- First, get current inventory id for each set and minifig
set_current_inv AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(id) AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
    GROUP BY set_num
),
minifig_current_inv AS (
    SELECT fig_num, MAX(id) AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE fig_num IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)
    GROUP BY fig_num
),
-- Recursive expansion: for a given root set, find all parts at all levels
-- We'll build paths from root sets through nested sets/minifigs to parts
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start from each set's direct parts
    SELECT 
        sci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ip.part_num = '11170pr0009'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: parts from nested sets (level 1 of nesting)
    SELECT 
        sci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (is.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
        2 AS level
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_sets ist ON ist.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    JOIN set_current_inv sci2 ON sci2.set_num = ist.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci2.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ip.part_num = '11170pr0009'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: parts from minifigs directly in set
    SELECT 
        sci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (im.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
        2 AS level
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    JOIN minifig_current_inv mci ON mci.fig_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ip.part_num = '11170pr0009'
),
-- Need true recursion for deeper nesting (sets inside sets inside sets, etc.)
-- Actually, let's use a proper recursive CTE
deeper AS (
    -- Base: all inventory items as starting points with their containers
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        i.fig_num,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS parent_set,
        0 AS depth
    FROM inventories i
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Find sets that contain these inventories through inventory_sets
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        i.fig_num,
        ist.set_num AS parent_set,
        d.depth + 1
    FROM deeper d
    JOIN inventory_sets ist ON ist.set_num = d.set_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.id = ist.inventory_id
    WHERE d.depth < 10
),
-- Actually, let's simplify: find all sets whose exploded contents contain the part
-- Use recursive CTE starting from the part occurrences
part_locations AS (
    -- Direct: part in set inventory
    SELECT DISTINCT sci.set_num
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '11170pr0009' AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION
    
    -- In nested sets: find sets that contain sets having the part
    SELECT DISTINCT sci.set_num
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_sets ist ON ist.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    WHERE ist.set_num IN (
        -- Recursive: sets that contain the part
        WITH RECURSIVE sets_with_part AS (
            -- Base: sets with direct part
            SELECT sci2.set_num
            FROM set_current_inv sci2
            JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci2.inventory_id
            WHERE ip.part_num = '11170pr0009' AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
            
            UNION
            
            -- Sets containing minifigs that have the part
            SELECT sci2.set_num
            FROM set_current_inv sci2
            JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci2.inventory_id
            JOIN minifig_current_inv mci ON mci.fig_num = im.fig_num
            JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mci.inventory_id
            WHERE ip.part_num = '11170pr0009' AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
        )
        SELECT set_num FROM sets_with_part
    )
)

set_inv AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(id) AS inv_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
    GROUP BY set_num
),
-- All inventory items (parts, nested sets, minifigs) with their container
items AS (
    -- Parts directly in inventories
    SELECT inventory_id, part_num, color_id, quantity, NULL::VARCHAR AS child_set, NULL::VARCHAR AS child_fig
    FROM inventory_parts WHERE is_spare = FALSE
    UNION ALL
    -- Nested sets
    SELECT inventory_id, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::INT, quantity, set_num, NULL::VARCHAR
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    -- Minifigs
    SELECT inventory_id, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::INT, quantity, NULL::VARCHAR, fig_num
    FROM inventory_minifigs
),
-- Recursive expansion starting from each set
expanded AS (
    -- Base: items in the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        si.set_num AS root_set,
        i.part_num,
        i.color_id,
        i.quantity,
        i.child_set,
        i.child_fig,
        CAST(i.inventory_id AS VARCHAR) AS path
    FROM set_inv si
    JOIN items i ON i.inventory_id = si.inv_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        i.part_num,
        i.color_id,
        e.quantity * i.quantity,
        i.child_set,
        i.child_fig,
        e.path || ',' || CAST(i.inventory_id AS VARCHAR)
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN set_inv si ON si.set_num = e.child_set
    JOIN items i ON i.inventory_id = si.inv_id
    WHERE e.child_set IS NOT NULL
      AND POSITION(',' || CAST(si.inv_id AS VARCHAR) IN e.path) = 0  -- cycle detection

        i.part_num,

)

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get current inventory for each set (max version)
current_set_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) 
        id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),
-- Get current inventory for each minifig
current_minifig_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) 
        id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of a set
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with sets released in 2015
    SELECT 
        s.set_num as root_set,
        s.set_num as current_item,
        'set' as item_type,
        1 as quantity,
        0 as depth
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2015
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in set inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num as current_item,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.quantity * e.quantity as quantity,
        e.depth + 1 as depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_set_inventories csi ON csi.set_num = e.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = csi.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set' AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        iset.set_num as current_item,
        'set' as item_type,
        iset.quantity * e.quantity as quantity,
        e.depth + 1 as depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_set_inventories csi ON csi.set_num = e.current_item
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = csi.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        im.fig_num as current_item,
        'minifig' as item_type,
        im.quantity * e.quantity as quantity,
        e.depth + 1 as depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_set_inventories csi ON csi.set_num = e.current_item
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifig inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num as current_item,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.quantity * e.quantity as quantity,
        e.depth + 1 as depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_minifig_inventories cmi ON cmi.set_num = e.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = cmi.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig' AND ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) as num_sets
FROM exploded e
JOIN colors c ON c.name = 'Yellow'
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = e.current_item
WHERE e.item_type = 'part'

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE theme_hierarchy AS (
  -- Get 'Educational and Dacta' theme and all its descendants
  SELECT id, name, parent_id
  FROM themes
  WHERE name = 'Educational and Dacta'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
  FROM themes t
  JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
sets_2018 AS (
  -- All sets from 2018 in the theme or its sub-themes
  SELECT s.set_num
  FROM sets s
  JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
  WHERE s.year = 2018
),
current_inventory AS (
  -- Current inventory for each set/minifig
  SELECT 
    set_num,
    id AS inventory_id
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      set_num,
      id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
  -- Base: start with each set's current inventory
  SELECT 
    s.set_num as root_set,
    ci.inventory_id,
    1 as quantity_multiplier,
    'set' as item_type,
    s.set_num as item_id
  FROM sets_2018 s
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Parts from inventory_parts (leaf nodes, don't recurse further)
  SELECT 
    e.root_set,
    NULL as inventory_id,
    e.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity as quantity_multiplier,
    'part' as item_type,
    ip.part_num as item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
    AND ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Nested sets from inventory_sets
  SELECT 
    e.root_set,
    ci.inventory_id,
    e.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity as quantity_multiplier,
    'set' as item_type,
    iset.set_num as item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
  WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Minifigs from inventory_minifigs
  SELECT 
    e.root_set,
    ci.inventory_id,
    e.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity as quantity_multiplier,
    'minifig' as item_type,
    im.fig_num as item_id
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
  WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT SUM(quantity_multiplier) as total_parts
FROM exploded
WHERE item_type = 'part'"}

WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
    -- Get the 'Juniors' theme and all its descendants
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Juniors'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
set_inventories AS (
    -- For each set in Juniors theme (including sub-themes) in 2017, get its current inventory
    SELECT s.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE s.year = 2017
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = s.set_num)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with each set's inventory
    SELECT 
        si.set_num AS root_set,
        si.inventory_id,
        1 AS set_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        si.set_num AS item_id,
        si.inventory_id AS child_inventory_id
    FROM set_inventories si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.inventory_id,
        e.set_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id,
        NULL AS child_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.child_inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.inventory_id,
        e.set_multiplier * iset.quantity AS set_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id,
        i.id AS child_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.child_inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON iset.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.inventory_id,
        e.set_multiplier * im.quantity AS set_multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        i.id AS child_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.child_inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON im.fig_num = i.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
),
-- Get all parts from exploded items
all_parts AS (
    -- Parts from set inventories (already in exploded)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.set_multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        ip.part_num
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.child_inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifig inventories

        e.root_set,
        e.set_multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        ip.part_num
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.child_inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT SUM(total_quantity) AS total_parts
FROM all_parts

-- Find all Duplo themes (Duplo and all sub-themes)
duplo_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Duplo'
    UNION ALL

),
-- Get all sets released in 2017 in Duplo theme (including sub-themes)
duplo_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name
    FROM sets s
    JOIN duplo_themes dt ON s.theme_id = dt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2017
),
-- Find current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with each Duplo set, quantity 1
    SELECT 
        ds.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        ds.set_num AS item_id
    FROM duplo_sets ds
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ds.set_num = ci.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci2.inventory_id,
        e.quantity * iset.quantity AS quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: minifigs (they have their own inventories)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci3.inventory_id,
        e.quantity * im.quantity AS quantity,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci3 ON im.fig_num = ci3.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),
-- Get all parts from exploded items (sets and minifigs)
all_parts AS (
    -- Parts from set inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set' AND ip.is_spare = false

    -- Parts from minifig inventories

    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig' AND ip.is_spare = false
)

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
    -- Get Architecture theme and all its sub-themes
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Architecture'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
-- Get all sets in Architecture theme (including sub-themes) released in 2016
architecture_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2016
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive explosion of contents
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with each architecture set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.inventory_id AS current_inv_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS nesting_level
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN architecture_sets a ON ci.set_num = a.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: inventory_sets points to another set, which has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        ci2.inventory_id AS current_inv_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        rc.qty * iset.quantity * ip.quantity AS qty,
        rc.nesting_level + 1
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON rc.current_inv_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci2.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: minifig has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        i2.id AS current_inv_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        rc.qty * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS qty,
        rc.nesting_level + 1
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON rc.current_inv_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON im.fig_num = i2.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON i2.id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM recursive_contents"}

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory IDs for all sets released in 2020
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num, 1 AS set_quantity
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN sets s ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE s.year = 2020
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),

-- Recursive explosion: start with sets, then expand nested sets and minifigs
exploded AS (
    -- Base: the sets themselves (as items to expand)
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        ci.set_num,
        ci.set_quantity,
        0 AS level,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: each nested set contributes its own inventory
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        inv_s.set_num,
        e.set_quantity * inv_s.quantity AS set_quantity,
        e.level + 1 AS level,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets inv_s ON inv_s.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = inv_s.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND child_inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = child_inv.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: each minifig contributes its own inventory
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        inv_m.fig_num AS set_num,
        e.set_quantity * inv_m.quantity AS set_quantity,
        e.level + 1 AS level,
        'minifig' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs inv_m ON inv_m.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = inv_m.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND child_inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = child_inv.set_num)
),

-- Get all unique inventory IDs with their total multipliers
inventory_multipliers AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, SUM(set_quantity) AS total_multiplier
    FROM exploded
    GROUP BY inventory_id
),

-- Sum parts from all inventories
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        SUM(ip.quantity * im.total_multiplier) AS total_quantity

    JOIN inventory_multipliers im ON im.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND ip.part_num = '54384'
    AND ip.color_id = 0
    GROUP BY ip.part_num, ip.color_id
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_quantity, 0) AS total FROM all_parts

    JOIN sets_2014 s ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at all levels (nested sets and minifigs)

exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

    JOIN current_inventories ci ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id

    -- Minifigs: inventory_minifigs points to a minifig, which has its own inventory

    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
)

-- Find all themes under 'Super Heroes Marvel' (including itself)
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes Marvel'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
-- Get all sets in 2025 with those themes
sets_2025 AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name, s.year, s.theme_id
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2025
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN sets_2025 s ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
),
-- Recursive explosion of contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * im.quantity AS qty,
        2 AS level
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mi.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND mi.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = mi.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * iset.quantity * e.qty AS qty,
        e.level + 1 AS level
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = e.root_set 
        AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.root_set)
    )
    JOIN inventories ni ON ni.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ni.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND ni.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ni.set_num)
      AND e.level < 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT color_id) AS distinct_colors
FROM exploded"}

base_inventory AS (

  FROM inventories i

),

-- Recursive expansion: at each step we expand nested sets and minifigs
-- Each row represents: for one unit of the current item, what's its contribution
exploded AS (
  -- Base: the base inventory itself
  SELECT 
    bi.inventory_id,
    bi.quantity AS path_quantity,
    'set' AS item_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS part_num,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS color_id,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS nested_inventory_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS fig_num
  FROM base_inventory bi
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Expand nested sets in inventory_sets: each nested set brings its current inventory
  SELECT 
    e.inventory_id,
    e.path_quantity * isets.quantity AS path_quantity,
    'set' AS item_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS part_num,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS color_id,
    i.id AS nested_inventory_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS fig_num
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets isets ON isets.inventory_id = e.nested_inventory_id OR 
    (e.item_type = 'set' AND e.nested_inventory_id IS NULL AND isets.inventory_id = e.inventory_id)
  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = isets.set_num
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set' AND (e.nested_inventory_id IS NOT NULL OR e.inventory_id = isets.inventory_id)
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Expand minifigs in inventory_minifigs: each minifig brings its current inventory
  SELECT 
    e.inventory_id,
    e.path_quantity * im.quantity AS path_quantity,
    'minifig' AS item_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS part_num,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS color_id,
    i.id AS nested_inventory_id,
    im.fig_num
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.nested_inventory_id OR 
    (e.item_type = 'set' AND e.nested_inventory_id IS NULL AND im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id)
  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set' AND (e.nested_inventory_id IS NOT NULL OR e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id)
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)

  SELECT nested_inventory_id, path_quantity FROM exploded WHERE nested_inventory_id IS NOT NULL

    ai.path_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
  FROM all_inventories ai

)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory (version 4) and version 1 of MULTIPACK-1
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = 'MULTIPACK-1' AND version = 4
),
v1_inv AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = 'MULTIPACK-1' AND version = 1
),

-- Recursive CTE to get all parts at any level for current inventory
-- We explode: inventory_parts directly, plus nested sets and minifigs recursively
current_parts(level, inventory_id, part_num, quantity, path) AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from current inventory (non-spare)
    SELECT 0, ip.inventory_id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity, ip.part_num::VARCHAR
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: for each inventory_set, get that set's current inventory parts
    SELECT cp.level + 1, i2.id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * iset.quantity, cp.path || '->' || iset.set_num
    FROM current_parts cp
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = cp.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num
    -- i2 must be the current (max version) inventory for that set
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON mv.set_num = i2.set_num AND i2.version = mv.max_ver
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: for each minifig, get its current inventory parts
    SELECT cp.level + 1, i2.id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * im.quantity, cp.path || '->' || im.fig_num
    FROM current_parts cp
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = cp.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON mv.set_num = i2.set_num AND i2.version = mv.max_ver
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
),

-- Same for version 1
v1_parts(level, inventory_id, part_num, quantity, path) AS (
    SELECT 0, ip.inventory_id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity, ip.part_num::VARCHAR
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN v1_inv vi ON ip.inventory_id = vi.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT vp.level + 1, i2.id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * iset.quantity, vp.path || '->' || iset.set_num
    FROM v1_parts vp
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = vp.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON mv.set_num = i2.set_num AND i2.version = mv.max_ver
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT vp.level + 1, i2.id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * im.quantity, vp.path || '->' || im.fig_num
    FROM v1_parts vp
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = vp.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON mv.set_num = i2.set_num AND i2.version = mv.max_ver
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

-- Get distinct part numbers in current but not in v1
SELECT DISTINCT cp.part_num
FROM current_parts cp
WHERE cp.part_num NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT vp.part_num FROM v1_parts vp)
ORDER BY cp.part_num

    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories (excluding spare parts)

        ci.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

        NULL AS color_id,

        'minifig' AS item_type,

    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'

    -- Expand minifigs: get their parts

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory for set 10785-1
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '10785-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Direct parts in the set's own inventory (excluding spare parts)
direct_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ip.quantity), 0) AS total_direct_parts
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN set_inventory si ON ip.inventory_id = si.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents including nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the source: 'direct' for parts in the set's own inventory, 'nested' for parts from nested sets/minifigs
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        si.inventory_id,
        1 AS set_quantity,
        'root' AS source_type
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.set_quantity * iset.quantity AS set_quantity,
        'nested' AS source_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.source_type != 'minifig'  -- sets can contain nested sets and minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into minifigs
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.set_quantity * im.quantity AS set_quantity,
        'minifig' AS source_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE e.source_type != 'minifig'  -- minifigs don't contain other minifigs or sets
),
-- Get all parts from all exploded inventories
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.source_type,
        e.set_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
-- Sum parts by source
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_type = 'root' THEN total_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS direct_from_own_inventory,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_type != 'root' THEN total_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS from_nested_and_minifigs,
        COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS total_parts
    FROM all_parts
)
SELECT 
    direct_from_own_inventory,
    from_nested_and_minifigs,
    total_parts,
    ROUND(from_nested_and_minifigs * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_parts, 0), 2) AS percentage_from_nested_and_minifigs
FROM totals
"}

),
-- Get max version for each set_num

    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
-- Recursive expansion of all nested items
expanded(item_type, item_id, quantity, level) AS (
    -- Seed with nested sets
    SELECT 'set', set_num, quantity, 1
    FROM direct_sets
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Seed with minifigs
    SELECT 'minifig', fig_num, quantity, 1
    FROM direct_minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand a set: get its parts, nested sets, minifigs
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ip.part_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'part'
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
        END,
        COALESCE(ip.part_num, iset.set_num, im.fig_num),

        expanded.level + 1

    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE expanded.item_type = 'set'

    WHERE expanded.item_type = 'minifig'
)
